name: Git History Storyteller
description: An AI-powered GitHub repository intelligence tool that turns raw commit history into narratives, contributor profiles, and onboarding guides using the Gemini API. A RAG pipeline backed by pgvector enables semantic Q&A over a repository's full history through a Python gitingest bridge, with a circuit-breaker-backed LLM provider system that falls back between Gemini and local Ollama models.
features: Turns raw commit history into repository narratives and onboarding guides
Builds contributor profiles from GitHub activity
Supports semantic Q&A over repository history with a pgvector-backed RAG pipeline
Uses a Python gitingest bridge for repository ingestion
Falls back between Gemini and local Ollama providers through a circuit-breaker-backed LLM layer
